doc.title: Bernie Kirsh interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, August 27, 2022

title: Hearing protection on tour
summary: Some high-end hearing loss and using earplugs on the Return to Forever tour.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians

blocks.x: Are you protective of your hearing?

Somewhat. Not — I try not to listen too loud. I mean I had my hearing checked a little over a year ago I guess, within the last couple of years and there was some high end loss, not much you know. So it’s still doing pretty good. But yeah. You know I’ll — if there’s loud sounds — I did a “Return to Forever” tour which can get kind of loud. I put things in my ears.
